::: {#exr-gradient-of-linear}

#### A gradient that does not mention its variable

Fix

$$A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 & 0 \\ 4 & 3 & -2 \end{bmatrix}$$

let $W \in \mathbb{R}^{2 \times 3}$ vary, and define

$$g(W) = \sum_{i=1}^{2} \sum_{j=1}^{3} W_{ij} A_{ij}$$

which is the entry-by-entry version of the inner product for matrices.
Compute $\nabla_W\, g(W)$,
and say what is unusual about the answer.

:::
